sessions.notes: Sprint 2 Session 3. 22 findings in findings/findings_wine_canonical.md: 9 P0, 8 P1, 4 P2, 1 P3. Stratified 99-wine + 50-producer sample audited inline by Opus 4.6 (pivoted from Sonnet API — $0 actual vs $18 pre-auth). Headline: (F1) 8/10 marquee wines broken (Vega Sicilia missing, DRC/Lafite wrong color, Opus One/Dom Pérignon/Screaming Eagle NULL display_name, Grange matched to 'by Nigo' limited edition, Hill of Grace matched to Museum Release); (F2) Chardonnay/Pinot Blanc grape bug is systemic — 2,743 of 2,809 Chardonnay-named wines (97.6%) have Pinot Blanc linked; (F3) all 15 famous producers have 0 metadata (DRC, Lafite, Latour, Margaux, Haut-Brion, Pétrus, Gaja, etc. — website/year/coords all NULL); (F4) Domaine Leroy tagged region=Beaujolais; (F5) Catena/Alta Vista producer collision; (F7) invented grape GARRO on Messina Hof (actual grape is Lenoir/Black Spanish, primary-source verified); (F10) AI content confabulates narratives when data is wrong — Joseph Phelps Eisele ai_summary claims Phelps bought Eisele in 2013 (actual: Artemis/Latour, primary-source verified); (F14) geology fabrication (Hunter Valley 'volcanic', Santa Ynez 'Franciscan shale'); (F19) Bruno Clair CCdB textbook classification error. 3 primary-source WebFetch verifications, all confirmed Loam wrong. Top Sprint 3 sequence: (a) S2.2 F1 staging relink → (b) S2.3 F3 producer seed → (c) F2/F7/F8 grape repair → (d) F6 color repair → (e) F10 L3 re-fact-check → (f) content regeneration.

sessions.name: Wine expert — reference content
sessions.notes: Sprint 2 Session 4. 30 findings in findings/findings_wine_reference.md: 8 P0, 14 P1, 7 P2, 1 P3. Opus inline + 1 WebFetch verification, $0 actual vs $0 planned. Headline: (F1) varietal_categories has confirmed wrong-grape links on Merlot→Grolleau Noir, Riesling→Crouchen, Verdejo→Trousseau Noir, Greco→Albana Bianca, St. Laurent→Muscat St. Laurent — 5+ P0 errors in 161-row categorization table. (F2) Root cause of S2.3 F2 (Chardonnay/Pinot Blanc bug) identified: PINOT BLANC has VIVC synonyms PINOT CHARDONNAY, CHARDONNET PINOT BLANC, PINOT BLANC CHARDONNET, plus PINOT GRIGIO (which is actually Pinot Gris). (F3) 121 famous appellations stored with slash-concatenated alias names (Hermitage / Ermitage / L'Hermitage / L'Ermitage, Porto / Port). (F4) French AOC names missing diacritics (Echezeaux should be Échézeaux, Saint-Emilion variants). (F5) Pauillac 1855 classification has 3 of 5 tier counts wrong (says 1 Premier Cru but names 3, claims 1 Troisième when Pauillac has 0). (F6) grapes.name uses VIVC cépage+suffix form (CHARDONNAY BLANC, MERLOT NOIR, TEMPRANILLO TINTO) causing cascade issues. (F7) 921 grape-synonym primary-name collisions confirmed (re-ran S2.1 F7 with higher precision). (F8) S2.3 F7 CORRECTION: GARRO is a real VIVC grape #7326, not invented — error is in wine_grapes linkage, not grapes table. (F9) established_year poisoned with fake 1973 default on 240 FR + 105 IT appellations (Chambertin actual 1936, Barolo DOC 1966, Champagne 1936). (F10) classification_level dominated by German einzellage — only 2 rows tagged grand_cru, zero tagged docg/doc/ava/cru_classe. (F11) appellation_rules JSONB has no stable schema — Petit Chablis uses {Chardonnay:100} while Chambertin uses {principal:Pinot Noir}. (F18) Hunter Valley linked to Basalt in appellation_soils, likely reinforcing S2.3 F14 volcanic confabulation. Sprint 3 grape-repair workstream refined to 5-step sequence (3a grapes.name cleanup → 3b synonym collision resolution + F2 synonym delete → 3c varietal_categories fix → 3d wine_grapes resolver re-run → 3e rules JSONB backfill). No scope-breakers.

Headline: (F1) describe-chemical edge function is dead code, deployed ACTIVE with verify_jwt=false, uses shared ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, has zero wine logic — unauthenticated credit-burn risk, delete; (F2) Code root cause of S2.3 F2 Chardonnay/Pinot Blanc identified — batch_pipeline._match_ttb_to_wine collapses 4 grape-specific COLAs (Chardonnay/Cab/Shiraz/Shiraz) onto 1 canonical wine for ~2,700 wines, compounded by ttb_grape_promote's DISTINCT ON arbitrary pick (F17); resolver in pipeline/lib/resolve.py is correct, bug is upstream dedup; (F3) relink_staging_to_current.py STAGING_TABLES_WINE lists only 1 of 30 staging tables — code-level cause of S2.2 F1 286K dangling wine_id pointers; (F4) enrich-wine edge function reads grapes.name (VIVC) not grapes.display_name — every Grade B prompt sees 'CHARDONNAY BLANC' not 'Chardonnay'; (F5) 3 Anthropic model IDs coexist without central config (haiku-4-5, sonnet-4, sonnet-4-6); (F11) 4+ duplicate grape lookup implementations across batch_pipeline/haiku_grape_extract/grape_from_name; (F18) lwin_long_tail.py inserts wines without display_name — 50,908 wines affected, biasing S2.3 F2 sample; (F24, F31) no supabase/migrations/ directory, edge function source not in git. Sprint 3 backlog: +23 items (9 P0 + 14 P1). Refined grape-repair workstream (3a-3e) extended with 3c.5 (fix multi-COLA collapse), 3c.6 (fix DISTINCT ON), 3c.7 (consolidate resolvers). Pre-Sprint-3 hygiene: delete describe-chemical, vendor enrich-wine source, centralize model IDs (~30 min combined).

sessions.name: Voice / editorial audit
sessions.notes: Sprint 2 Session 6. 32 findings in findings/findings_voice.md: 9 P0, 14 P1, 7 P2, 2 P3. Opus inline + MCP edge function read + ~20 verification SQL queries + LIKE-scan quantification across the 5,454-row enriched corpus. $0 actual spend. Headline: (F1) 346 reference-insight rows (202 regions + 82 appellations + 62 countries, all enriched 2026-03-06) written with weak reference-layer prompts that have only an 8-word marketing blocklist — no hedging/sommelier-theater/performative-enthusiasm rules. LIKE scan confirms: 50% of appellations contain 'elegant', 60% say 'volcanic', 71% say 'well-draining', 62% say 'ancient', 20% use 'force vines to struggle'. (F2) enrich-wine edge function (live, version 3, Grade B source) ships a weak preamble without banned-word lists, uses stale claude-sonnet-4-20250514, and reads grapes.name not display_name (overlaps S2.5 F4/F5/F31). Grade B LIKE scan: 59% contain 'likely', 52% 'showcases', 41% 'premium', 39% 'elegant' — validates Session-10 feature flag decision. (F3) Tightened voice rules in enrich_prompts.py reduced hedging 10-60x but do NOT prevent factual confabulation — 5 random Grade C hooks found with invented facts (Schramsberg J Schram described as 'still rosé', Perrin CdP narrated as 'white wine masquerading under red grapes', DRC Corton-Charlemagne falsely claims 'avoids MLF in most vintages', Merry Edwards '40 years' when founded 1997, Pax Obsidian 'likely 14.5%+' ABV fabrication). (F4) 487 Chardonnay+Pinot Blanc wines (S2.3 F2 / S2.5 F2 polluted grape pair) have wine_insights where Claude confabulates backstories — Waterbrook Icon rationalizes '100% Chardonnay with 75% Pinot Blanc' (175% total) into editorial narrative. (F5) Contamination feedback loop traced end-to-end: Knights Valley appellation_insight confabulates 'volcanic soils from ancient Mayacamas eruptions' → edge function assembleContext injects it into Grade B wine prompts → Beringer Alluvium Grade B inherits claim, adds DIFFERENT wrong volcano ('Mount St. Helena eruptions'). Sonoma Coast + RRV + Howell Mountain all show parallel geology fabrications. (F6) grape_insights table has 0 rows despite grape_insights.py containing the best food-pairing prompt in Loam — VOICE.md-compliant classics-first structured guidance, never run. (F7) 99% of enriched wines (5,003 of 5,062 Grade C) have no food-pairing prose at all because GRADE_C_FIELDS schema drops the field. (F8) wine_food_pairings structured table is empty; CLAUDE.md claims 809 rows stale by that many (archive still has them). (F9) 82/82 appellation_insights are US AVAs, ZERO European grand crus/DOCGs/DOs — DRC Corton-Charlemagne Grade B prompt got no appellation context because Corton-Charlemagne has no insight row. Sprint 3 sequence refined: pre-req voice module consolidation (~4-6 hrs) closes 14 of 32 findings. L3 fact-check gate becomes mandatory for Sprint 5 regeneration pass. Reference-layer regeneration MUST precede wine-layer regeneration (contamination direction is one-way). Sprint 5 scope grows by ~500 European appellation_insights. Feature flag on enrich-wine stays OFF.

sessions.name: UX / frontend audit
sessions.notes:
Sprint 2 Session 7. 32 findings in findings/findings_ux.md: 9 P0, 14 P1, 7 P2, 2 P3. Opus inline + Supabase MCP verification queries + static analysis of 9 consumer pages + 9 shared components + 14 dev-explorer pages. $0 actual spend. Headline P0s: (F1) WinePage fetches wine.name not display_name; 12,083 active wines (7.8%) have NULL name but populated display_name and render empty

(verified sample: Ropiteau Pommard Premier Cru, Mommessin Châteauneuf-du-Pape, Ligeret Chambertin-Clos de Bèze Grand Cru). (F2) **CountryPage selects ai_signature_grapes which does not exist** — verified PGRST 42703 error by running exact query; actual column is ai_signature_styles (plural). 100% of country pages silently fail to render ai_overview because fetch errors and no .catch. (F3) 2,914 active wine pages render Chardonnay+Pinot Blanc chip combination (live-verified UI manifestation of S2.3 F2 / S2.5 F2); 493 of those also render confabulated wine_insights as italic ai_hook. (F4) ProducerPage is structurally empty — 0/10,676 producers have hectares/production/address/coords/description/philosophy/year_established/parent_producer_id/parent_company/appellation_id, 1 has website_url, 1 has producer_type. Dead sections: Philosophy NEVER renders, Estates & Labels NEVER renders, Details section header shows above near-empty FactGrid. S2.3 F3 undersells the scope. (F5) AI content rendered as plain text with NO confidence badge, NO AI disclaimer, NO source attribution across every consumer page. ConfidenceBadge + InsightsPanel exist but only wired to dev /data/* explorer. (F6) 16,429 active wine pages render contaminated 'volcanic' soil claim from appInsight.ai_soil_profile under MiniLabel 'Soil' as if about the wine's own vineyard (S2.6 F5 UI extension). (F7) Footer 'About' link goes to /about but only /dev/about is routed. (F8) /vineyard/:id route is dead — 0 vineyards in DB, search_catalog RPC doesn't include vineyard entity type, 232 LOC VineyardPage unreachable. (F9) Zero .catch() anywhere in consumer pages, no error boundary at App.tsx — F2 manifests as 'no content ever' instead of 'database error'. **Key P1s:** F10 no 404 catch-all route in App.tsx, F11 Dashboard queries producer_insights (0 rows, table exists but empty), F12 wineCount inflated by F-grade (96.7% of appellation wines are F per live query), F13 5,573 wines in 2,404 duplicate-name groups on 1,145 producers, F14 producer website URL non-clickable on consumer pages but clickable on dev ProducerDetail, F15 dev WineDetail.tsx:37 reads grapes.name not display_name (S2.5 F4 extension), **F16-F19 8 ai_* fields fetched and never rendered across AppellationPage (3), CountryPage (2), RegionPage (1), GrapePage (2)** — including ai_overview on appellation/region/country pages, F20 zero aria-current/aria-live/htmlFor/role anywhere (only 3 aria-label for hamburger), F21 h1→h3 heading skip in all 8 detail pages, F22 WinePage food pairing section invisible on 5,003 of 5,062 Grade C wines (S2.6 F7 UI extension), F23 classification system_name captured into state but never rendered (user sees 'Premier Cru' with no system). **P2s:** F24 Section header renders above empty FactGrid on ProducerPage, F25 EntityMap boundary_source raw, F26 VineyardPage map shows appellation not vineyard GPS, F27 500 LOC of Section/Tag/Fact/Loading/NotFound duplication across 8 pages, F28 Dashboard N+1 count queries uncached, F29 HomePage autoFocus pops mobile keyboard on load, F30 GrapePage wineCount inflated by Pinot Blanc bug. **P3s:** F31 LandingPage.tsx dead code, F32 build timestamp only on dev layouts. **Meta-patterns for S2.9:** (1) consumer frontend has NO error path — F9 is the structural reason F2 silently shipped; (2) dead fetches are endemic — 8 ai_* fields wasted, Sprint 5 could populate perfect Chambertin ai_overview and user would never see it; (3) structural empty states not handled — F4/F10/F22/F24 all point at 'UI was designed for a fully-populated world'; (4) AI content has no safety rail — F5/F6/F23 combine into 'credibility surface is invisible'; (5) dev explorer has more developer attention than consumer (F14/F15/useEntityDetail error handling); (6) every P0 is trivial-effort (<30 min combined). **Sprint 3 pre-reqs added (~3-4 hours UI hygiene):** F1/F2/F7/F8/F10/F11/F14/F15/F16-19/F20/F21/F22/F23/F24/F27 bundle. **Sprint 5 constraints locked:** AI disclaimer + confidence badge must ship before ENRICHMENT_ENABLED flip (F5), every new ai_* field must have consumer render (F16-F19), reference-first regen confirmed at UI layer (F6). 23 items (9 P0 + 14 P1) added to Sprint 3 backlog. Running Sprint 2 totals: 213 findings across S2.1+S2.2+S2.3+S2.4+S2.5+S2.6+S2.7, $0 spent / $25 ceiling. No scope-breakers. Tables touched: NONE (read-only audit). Docs written: findings_ux.md, prompts/s2_7_ux.md, journal.md S2.7 section, sessions.json (S2.7 → done), budget.json, CLAUDE.md, memory/project_sprint2_findings.md, data/sessions.md.
